name: Raid Bellanoir
description: Without existing, she quietly gazed upon the world. One day, she was seized with a longing to be seen. With unbridled lust for vengeance against reality, thus was born the Eclipsed Siren.

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Iris
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks targeted enemy with Nightmare Ray.  When this Pal uses Nightmare Ray,  it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.

title: Eclipsed Siren

name: Raid Bellanoir Libero
description: With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. She longed for a self to gaze upon herself.  And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality,  were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Stare
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks targeted enemy with Nightmare Bloom.  When this Pal uses Nightmare Bloom,  it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.

title: Twilight Siren

name: Raid Bellanoir Libero Ultra
description: With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. She longed for a self to gaze upon herself.  And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality,  were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.

partnerSkill.name: No Partner Skill
partnerSkill.description: This pal has no partner skill information likely due to being a boss.

title: Twilight Siren (Ultra)

name: Raid Blazamut Ryu
description: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  improves player's and Pals' Dragon damage to enemy weak points by 25%. (Does not stack)

title: Incarnation of the Eternal Flame

name: Raid Blazamut Ryu Ultra
description: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.

partnerSkill.name: No Partner Skill
partnerSkill.description: This pal has no partner skill information likely due to being a boss.

title: Incarnation of the Eternal Flame (Ultra)

name: Nyafia
description: Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye.  If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks.

partnerSkill.name: Shot-Nyan Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time.   While in party,  increases the player's shotgun damage by 10%. (Does not stack)

name: Prunelia
description: Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor,  it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles. However, when encountered at night,  its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.

partnerSkill.name: Prayer for Abundant Harvest
partnerSkill.description: While at a base,  Prunelia's prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest by 18%.

name: Alpha Melpaca
description: Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance.  A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may  send you flying to the other side of the world.

partnerSkill.name: Pacapaca Wool
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party,  increases Kingpaca's Defense and Movement Speed.  Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

title: Pompous Shanks

name: Alpha Kitsun
description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee  into a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.

partnerSkill.name: Wolf of the Sun
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Ice damage and are immune to Freeze. (Does not stack)

title: Guardian of the Azure Flame

name: Alpha Anubis
description: Once seen as a symbol of nobility,  and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Desert
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Anubis changes the player's attack type to Earth and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.  Occasionally evades attacks with a flash sidestep during battle.

title: Guardian of the Dark Sun

name: Alpha Nyafia
description: Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye.  If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks.

partnerSkill.name: Shot-Nyan Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time.   While in party,  increases the player's shotgun damage by 10%. (Does not stack)

title: Night Shade Hunter

name: Alpha Incineram
description: In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.

partnerSkill.name: Flameclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks the targeted enemy with Hellfire Claw.  When this Pal uses Hellfire Claw,  it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.

title: Hyena of the Wild

name: Alpha Incineram Noct
description: It specifically targets baby Pals, taking them back to its domain. One can only imagine the profound despair of a parent whose child has been taken away.

partnerSkill.name: Darkclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks the targeted enemy with Nightmare Claw.  When this Pal uses Nightmare Claw,  it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.

title: Hyena of the Darkest Night

name: Alpha Mau
description: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who were poached as a result, they were anything but.

partnerSkill.name: Gold Digger
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to Ranch.

title: Noble Glimmer

name: Alpha Mau Cryst
description: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Whispers
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch.

title: Serene Glimmer

name: Alpha Caprity
description: The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

partnerSkill.name: Berry Picker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to Ranch.  While in party,  restores 100 Pal’s Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)

title: Walking Farm

name: Alpha Vanwyrm
description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While in party,  increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 20%. (Does not stack)

title: Aerial Marauder

name: Alpha Vanwyrm Cryst
description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst  are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While in party,  increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 30%. (Does not stack)

title: Marauder of Frozen Skies

name: Alpha Necromus
description: Once one with Paladius.  Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions.  However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knight of the Abyss
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.  When Twin Spears skill is activated, a Paladius in your party will appear and attack alongside you.

title: Dark Knight of Legend

name: Alpha Shadowbeak
description: Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence defies reason. Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Modified DNA
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying,  Movement Speed is increased.  Enhances Dark attacks by 15% while mounted.

title: Unknown Life Form

name: Alpha Astegon
description: A savage beast born of the abyss.  Thou shall not stand before the beast.  Thou shall not heed the beast.

partnerSkill.name: Black Ankylosaur
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  Increases the damage dealt to ores by 1100%, and you can obtain 150% more Ore while mounted.

title: Draconic Monarch of Steel

name: Alpha Prunelia
description: Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor,  it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles. However, when encountered at night,  its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.

partnerSkill.name: Prayer for Abundant Harvest
partnerSkill.description: While at a base,  Prunelia's prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest by 18%.

title: Indigo Handmaiden

name: Alpha Azurobe
description: This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water.  Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted.  This past has left them bitter towards humanity.

partnerSkill.name: Waterwing Dance
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water.  While mounted,  changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Lady of the Lake

name: Alpha Fuack
description: Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere.  It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends  in a fatal collision.

partnerSkill.name: Surfing Slam
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.

title: Rowdy Wave Ripper

name: Alpha Rushoar
description: Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength.  Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.

partnerSkill.name: Hard Head
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases efficiency of destroying Stone by 500%.

title: Woodland Ruffian

name: Alpha Lapiron
description: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.

partnerSkill.name: Friend of Earth
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases the player's Defense by 50% while sprinting. (Does not stack)

title: Indomitable Racer

name: Alpha Penking
description: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet. However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases,  for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.

partnerSkill.name: Brave Sailor
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  Fire Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

title: Pioneer of the Frozen Sea

name: Alpha Lifmunk
description: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child.  It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases  where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

partnerSkill.name: Lifmunk Recoil
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  leaps onto the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follows up player attacks.

title: Coward of the Steppe

name: Alpha Tombat
description: Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals.  Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic,  the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.

partnerSkill.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap.

title: Trickster

name: Alpha Katress
description: With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen.

partnerSkill.name: Mystical Black Magic
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  Normal Pals drop 40% more items when defeated.  Also has a 10% chance to prevent Pal Sphere consumption when thrown.  (Does not stack)

title: Phantasmal Feline

name: Alpha Katress Ignis
description: Due to its upbringing,  it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough.  This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible.  Not on good terms with Wixen Noct.

partnerSkill.name: Blazing Black Magic
partnerSkill.description: While at a base,  increases the Kindling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

title: Fire-Licked Feline

name: Alpha Felbat
description: Attacking from the shadows, this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings. It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.

partnerSkill.name: Life Steal
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together,  grants the player and Felbat a life steal effect that restores 5% of damage dealt as Health.

title: Gloom-Shrouded Bloodsucker

name: Alpha Chikipi
description: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside Lamball. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

partnerSkill.name: Egg Layer
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to Ranch.

title: Plump & Juicy

name: Alpha Tocotoco
description: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs.  It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense,  but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.

partnerSkill.name: Eggbomb Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  equips to the player and transforms into  an egg launcher.

title: Boom or Bust

name: Alpha Mozzarina
description: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet,  regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

partnerSkill.name: Milk Maker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Milk when assigned to Ranch.

title: Prime Beef

name: Alpha Cinnamoth
description: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria.  There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct,  but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures,  putting a stop to them.

partnerSkill.name: Mysterious Scales
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks the targeted enemy with Poison Fog.  While at a base,  increases the Farming Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

title: Butterfly Promenade

name: Alpha Vixy
description: The idol of Palpagos Island. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

partnerSkill.name: Dig Here!
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch.

title: Star of the Steppe

name: Alpha Fuddler
description: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness.  However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy,  leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.

partnerSkill.name: Mining Assistance
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  improves player mining efficiency by 30% and reduces Stone weight by 80%.  (Does not stack)

title: Underground Explorer

name: Alpha Cawgnito
description: Long ago it freely soared the skies.  After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies,  and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.

partnerSkill.name: Eerie Nightstreaker
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  grants Night Vision to see in dark places. Activate again to turn off.  Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch.

title: Shadow-Cloaked Schemer

name: Alpha Menasting
description: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Scorpion
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  player's Defense increases by 5%, and Electricity Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

title: Unstoppable Stinger

name: Alpha Menasting Terra
description: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are struck by it can only let out hellish groans.

partnerSkill.name: Golden Scorpion
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  player's Defense increases by 5%, and Electricity Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

title: Gold-Piercing Spear

name: Alpha Eikthyrdeer
description: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers  becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Forest
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by 220%.

title: Protector of the Herd

name: Alpha Eikthyrdeer Terra
description: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Golden Forest
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  Can perform a double jump while mounted.  While at a base,  increases the Lumbering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1 (Does not stack)

title: Golden Antlers

name: Alpha Daedream
description: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

partnerSkill.name: Dream Chaser
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  appears near the player.  Attacks hostile enemies with  Dark magic bullets. These bullets will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

title: Dream Eater

name: Alpha Digtoise
description: A Digtoise possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it, ponders the contradictions of the world in the popular children's tale, |Digtoise's Fable|.

partnerSkill.name: Drill Crusher
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  enters the Shell Spin state.  Follows the player while spinning, increasing ore mining efficiency by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

title: Drilling Machine

name: Alpha Galeclaw
description: A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human.  It is, however, prone to letting go when tired,  which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

partnerSkill.name: Galeclaw Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  modifies the performance of the equipped glider.  Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand.

title: Proud Courier

name: Alpha Sparkit
description: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.

partnerSkill.name: Static Electricity
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Attack of Electricity Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)  Sometimes drops Electric Organ when assigned to Ranch.

title: Livewire Tabby

name: Alpha Boltmane
description: The more it moves, the more it heats up and the hair tips increasingly glow brighter. At its peak, it becomes so dazzling that you risk blindness if you stare at it directly.

partnerSkill.name: Ride
partnerSkill.description: This Pal is under investigation.

title: en_Text

name: Alpha Grizzbolt
description: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique,  it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change  when wielding a minigun.

partnerSkill.name: Yellow Tank
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted.

title: Claws of Lightning

name: Alpha Elphidran
description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Holy Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying,  Movement Speed is increased.  While in party,  Dark Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

title: Gentle Sky Dragon

name: Alpha Elphidran Aqua
description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Water Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased.  While in party,  player and party Pals take 15% less Fire damage and are immune to Burn.  (Does not stack)

title: Beast of the Tides

name: Alpha Fenglope
description: In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelt and antlers were often seen in works of art.

partnerSkill.name: Wind and Clouds
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

title: Drifting Cloud

name: Alpha Pyrin
description: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

partnerSkill.name: Red Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted,  changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Steed of Flames

name: Alpha Pyrin Noct
description: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted,  changes the player’s attack type toDark and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Steed of Darkness

name: Alpha Rooby
description: Wild Rooby surprisingly never get sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.

partnerSkill.name: Tiny Spark
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Defense of Fire Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)  Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

title: Chief of the Herd

name: Alpha Arsox
description: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Warm Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains  Cold Resistance +2.  (Does not stack)

title: Blazing Brute

name: Alpha Dinossom
description: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified.  It rages on and on like an inferno.  The phrase |step on a Dinossom's tail| has come to mean enraging someone.

partnerSkill.name: Fragrant Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party,  increase Defense of Dragon Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)

title: Guardian of Blossoming Gardens

name: Alpha Dinossom Lux
description: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase |struck by a Dinossom Lux's bolt| has come to mean narrowly escaping death.

partnerSkill.name: Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party,  increases Defense of Electricity Pals by 15%.  (Does not stack)

title: Guardian of Lightning

name: Alpha Petallia
description: A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life.  Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms  and a new Petallia is born.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by 75%.   While at a base,  increases the Planting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

title: Lady of the Flower Garden

name: Alpha Petallia Ignis
description: A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life.  The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile,  allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.

partnerSkill.name: Passion of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by 80%.   While in party,  player and party Pals take 15% less Leaf damage, and are immune to Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)

title: Lady of the Ashen Wastes

name: Alpha Flopie
description: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation,  but hay fever has apparently become a problem for  Flopie as of late.

partnerSkill.name: Helper Bunny
partnerSkill.description: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

title: Star of the Flower Beds

name: Alpha Celaray
description: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases.  Should it find a partner along the way,  the encounter will mark its journey's end.

partnerSkill.name: Zephyr Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  modifies the performance of the equipped glider.   Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

title: Soaring Skyfish

name: Alpha Wixen
description: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress.

partnerSkill.name: Lord Fox
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Wixen changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

title: Fire-Licked Furball

name: Alpha Wixen Noct
description: Due to its upbringing,  it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible.  Not on good terms with Katress Ignis.

partnerSkill.name: Black Fox Lord
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Wixen Noct changes the player's attack type to Dark and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

title: Phantasmal Furball

name: Alpha Teafant
description: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

partnerSkill.name: Soothing Shower
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  restores 20% of the player's Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) ({ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}-second cooldown after activation)

title: Adorable Watering Can

name: Alpha Direhowl
description: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.

partnerSkill.name: Direhowl Rider
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Moves slightly faster than most mounts.

title: Hunter of the Steppe

name: Alpha Maraith
description: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.

partnerSkill.name: Messenger of Death
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  all Party Pals' Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by 30% whenever you defeat an enemy. (Does not stack)

title: Messenger of Death

name: Alpha Gildane
description: During the golden age of alchemy on the island,  its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold. In time, a remarkable revelation was made:  the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.

partnerSkill.name: Sandstorm's Blessing
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While mounted,  changes the player’s attack type to Earth and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Guardian Beast of Twilight

name: Alpha Gorirat
description: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades.  The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction  between them is still largely unknown.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat's Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}% for a limited time.

title: Jungle Punk

name: Alpha Gorirat Terra
description: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. Stronger than Gorirat, if every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Pound
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases the player's climbing speed by 50%. (Does not stack)

title: Up for a Brawl

name: Alpha Mammorest
description: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.

partnerSkill.name: Gaia Crusher
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by 220% and mining efficiency by 500%.

title: King of the Forest

name: Alpha Mammorest Cryst
description: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Crusher
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by 220% and mining efficiency by 500%.

title: King of the Tundra

name: Alpha Mossanda
description: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once! It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

title: Wanderer of the Forest

name: Alpha Mossanda Lux
description: A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body,  this Pal's been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

title: Inheritor of the Storm

name: Alpha Verdash
description: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.

partnerSkill.name: Grassland Gymnast
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  grants 1 additional jump and 1 additional mid-air dash. (Does not stack)

title: Gale of the Forest

name: Alpha Helzephyr
description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. Those who dies from Helzephyr's lightning are sure to have their soul sent to the underworld.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Death
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While mounted,  changes the player’s attack type to Dark and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Wings of The Underworld

name: Alpha Helzephyr Lux
description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. While considered a subspecies of Helzephyr, there's a theory that suggests Helzephyr Lux, struck by lightning from hell, will transform into Helzephyr.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Thunder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While mounted,  changes the player’s attack type to Electricity and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Wings of Netherstorm

name: Alpha Nitewing
description: It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them  as a surrogate parent.  Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.

partnerSkill.name: Travel Companion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.

title: Wings of the Firmament

name: Alpha Jolthog
description: It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack. The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  equips Jolthog to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Electricity explosion upon impact.

title: Don't Touch!

name: Alpha Jolthog Cryst
description: It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack.  The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air  and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

partnerSkill.name: Cold Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  equips Jolthog Cryst to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Ice explosion upon impact.

title: Watch Your Feet!

name: Alpha Warsect
description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.

partnerSkill.name: Cast-Iron Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in your party,  generates a barrier around the player after 5 melee hits are landed within 5 seconds. (Does not stack)

title: Gold-Armored Warrior

name: Alpha Faleris
description: When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames,  burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.

partnerSkill.name: Scorching Predator
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While in party,  Ice Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

title: Sentinel of Dawn

name: Alpha Reindrix
description: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen and smashed to pieces.

partnerSkill.name: Cool Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party,  the player gains Heat Resistance +2.  (Does not stack)

title: Frosthorn Beast

name: Alpha Foxcicle
description: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

partnerSkill.name: Aurora Guide
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Attack of Ice Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch.

title: Frostbound Fox

name: Alpha Frostallion
description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal winter.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Steed
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While mounted,  changes the player's attack type to Ice, inflict Freeze 2, increases Attack by 10%.

title: Legendary Steed of Ice

name: Alpha Frostallion Noct
description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Steed
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While mounted,  changes the player's attack type to Dark, inflict Blind 2, increases Attack by 10%.

title: Legendary Steed of Darkness

name: Alpha Jetragon
description: Watches over Palpagos Island from high above. When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open,  and the skies will burn. It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Missile
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

title: Legendary Celestial Dragon

name: Alpha Kelpsea
description: Its personality changes depending  on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally  ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

partnerSkill.name: Aqua Spout
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Attack of Water Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)  Sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids when assigned to Ranch.

title: Child of the Deep

name: Alpha Kelpsea Ignis
description: Its personality changes depending  on the temperature of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have  a passionate, motivated personality.

partnerSkill.name: Lava Spout
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Attack of Fire Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)  Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

title: Child of the Molten Depths

name: Alpha Kingpaca
description: Melpaca serve this Pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

partnerSkill.name: King of Muscles
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by 5% for each Melpaca in party.

title: Supreme Fluff Commander

name: Alpha Kingpaca Cryst
description: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca.

partnerSkill.name: Coldhearted King
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by 5% for each Melpaca in party.

title: Azure Fluff Commander

name: Alpha Blazamut
description: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by 5% whenever you defeat an enemy. This effect lasts 20 seconds and stacks up to five times.

title: Cursed Tyrant

name: Alpha Blazamut Ryu
description: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  improves player's and Pals' Dragon damage to enemy weak points by 25%. (Does not stack)

title: Incarnation of the Eternal Flame

name: Alpha Univolt
description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God,  and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Deity
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party,  improves player's and Pals' Electricity damage to weak points by 25%. (Does not stack)

title: Swift Deity

name: Alpha Univolt Cryst
description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God,  and thus was not hunted by people.  However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice,  its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Frigid Deity
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While mounted,  changes the player’s attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Blustery Blizzard Fiend

name: Alpha Foxparks
description: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Fire
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower.

title: Revealer of Paths

name: Alpha Flambelle
description: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body,  causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Tears
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by 0.1% per second outside of combat. (Does not stack)  Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

title: Molten Daughter

name: Alpha Dumud
description: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

partnerSkill.name: Soil Improver
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Attack of Earth Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)  Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch.

title: Perpetual Procrastinator

name: Alpha Relaxaurus
description: Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.

partnerSkill.name: Hungry Missile
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

title: Gluttonous Dragon

name: Alpha Relaxaurus Lux
description: One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!

partnerSkill.name: Missile Party
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

title: Gluttonous Thunder Dragon

name: Alpha Lyleen
description: A docile Pal full of love.  It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents.  It uses a full-power Solar Blast to discipline naughty Pals.

partnerSkill.name: Harvest Goddess
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by 80%.

title: Empress of Lilies

name: Alpha Lyleen Noct
description: An elegant Pal full of grace.  It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap.  Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.

partnerSkill.name: Goddess of the Tranquil Light
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  the queen's soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by 85%.

title: Empress of the Abyss

name: Alpha Bristla
description: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles while a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.

partnerSkill.name: Princess Gaze
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Attack of Leaf  Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)

title: Thorny Rose

name: Alpha Leezpunk
description: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.

partnerSkill.name: Too Cool to be Seen
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Leezpunk and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for {ActiveSkillOverWriteEffectTime} seconds.

title: Self-Proclaimed Genius

name: Alpha Leezpunk Ignis
description: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

partnerSkill.name: Too Cool to be Seen
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Leezpunk Ignis and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for {ActiveSkillOverWriteEffectTime} seconds.

title: Self-Proclaimed Fashionista

name: Alpha Blazehowl
description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burned to a crisp.

partnerSkill.name: Hellflame Lion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party, Leaf Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

title: Crimson Goliath

name: Alpha Blazehowl Noct
description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.

partnerSkill.name: Darkflame Lion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  Normal Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

title: Inferno Goliath

name: Alpha Tanzee
description: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns.

partnerSkill.name: Cheery Rifle
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

title: Dexterous Primate

name: Alpha Tanzee Ignis
description: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched.  When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.

partnerSkill.name: Chipper Chimp Gunfire
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Tanzee Ignis will mercilessly fire a Fire assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

title: Flame Aficionado

name: Alpha Swee
description: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Attack and Defense of Sweepa.

title: Curious Floof

name: Alpha Sweepa
description: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.

partnerSkill.name: King of Fluff
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by 12% for each Swee in party.

title: King of the Floof

name: Alpha Lunaris
description: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.

partnerSkill.name: Antigravity
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  spheres home in on Pals, and carrying capacity increases by 300. (Does not stack)

title: Extraterrestrial

name: Alpha Grintale
description: Grintale's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up.

partnerSkill.name: Glaring Cat's Eye
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  picking up a Pal Egg has a 50% chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)

title: Marshmallow Body

name: Alpha Depresso
description: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.

partnerSkill.name: Caffeine Inoculation
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Depresso chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.  Sometimes drops Venom Gland when assigned to Ranch.

title: Several Sleepless Nights Later

name: Alpha Killamari
description: It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides.  Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact  Killamari victims.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Squid
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  modifies the performance of the equipped glider.  Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

title: Emotionless

name: Alpha Nox
description: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should  leave it where it lays and leave immediately.  Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.

partnerSkill.name: Kuudere
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  detects the location of nearby Pal Effigies.

title: Nighttime Prince

name: Alpha Pengullet
description: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire Pengullet as ammunition.  Pengullet explodes on impact and is incapacitated.

title: Ate Too Much

name: Alpha Cattiva
description: At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by a Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

partnerSkill.name: Cat Helper
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity by 100.  (Does not stack)

title: The Cat's Pajamas

name: Alpha Lovander
description: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

partnerSkill.name: Heart Drain
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together,  grants the player and Lovander a life steal effect that restores 5% of damage dealt as Health.

title: Pal on the Prowl

name: Alpha Ribbuny
description: A Pal that's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva's pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic.

partnerSkill.name: Happy-Go-Lucky Bunny
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Attack of Normal Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)  While at a base,  increases the Handiwork Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

title: Heart-Melting Smile

name: Alpha Gumoss
description: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap.  It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover  its body with, eventually rotting away.

partnerSkill.name: Logging Assistance
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  improves logging efficiency by 30% and reduces weight of all types of wood by 40%. (Does not stack)

title: Suddenly Transformed

name: Alpha Gumoss
description: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap.  It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover  its body with, eventually rotting away.

partnerSkill.name: No Partner Skill
partnerSkill.description: This pal has no partner skill information likely due to being a boss.

title: Suddenly Transformed

name: Alpha Elizabee
description: A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes.  There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death  for the pleasure of serving their queen.

partnerSkill.name: Queen Bee Command
partnerSkill.description: This Pal's Attack increases by 12% for each Beegarde in party.

title: Empress of the Hive

name: Alpha Dazzi
description: Often kind to lonely Pals. However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship, it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  appears near the player.  Attacks hostile enemies with  Electricity bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

title: Born of the Storm

name: Alpha Ragnahawk
description: Some think it is a related species to Beakon, but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.

partnerSkill.name: Flame Wing
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While mounted,  changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Wings of Inferno

name: Alpha Robinquill
description: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans in the distant past.

partnerSkill.name: Grounded Archer
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases the player's bow damage by 10%. (Does not stack)

title: Archer of the Forest

name: Alpha Robinquill Terra
description: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.

partnerSkill.name: Master Archer
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases the player's bow charge speed by 15%. (Does not stack)

title: Archer of the Sands

name: Alpha Bushi
description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.

partnerSkill.name: Brandish Blade
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks targeted enemy with Iaigiri.  When this Pal uses Iaigiri,  it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.

title: Vagrant Warrior

name: Alpha Bushi Noct
description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart,  the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders.

partnerSkill.name: Void Blade
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks targeted enemy with Iaigiri.  When this Pal uses Iaigiri,  it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.  While in party,  increases the player's melee weapon damage by 30% but only when not in combat. (Does not stack)

title: Samurai of Darkness

name: Alpha Paladius
description: Once one with Necromus. Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions. However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.

partnerSkill.name: Holy Knight of the Firmament
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can triple jump while mounted.   Activate Spear Thrust to have Necromus stay by your side and attack enemies in tandem.

title: Holy Knight of Legend

name: Alpha Broncherry
description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the |Fragrance of First Love.|

partnerSkill.name: Love's First Blossom
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  Pal Eggs you pick up have a 35% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg.  (Does not stack)

title: Winds of Spring

name: Alpha Broncherry Aqua
description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the |Perfume of Purity.|

partnerSkill.name: Purity's Full Bloom
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  Pal Eggs you pick up have a 45% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg.  (Does not stack)

title: Waves of Summer

name: Alpha Surfent
description: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Swimmer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water.  Sometimes drops Leather when assigned to Ranch.

title: The Ocean's Wrath

name: Alpha Surfent Terra
description: Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Swimmer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party,  the player's attacks inflict Muddy 2. (Does not stack)

title: The Desert's Wrath

name: Alpha Gobfin
description: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks targeted enemy with Aqua Gun.  When this Pal uses Aqua Gun,  it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.  While in party,  increases the player's Attack by 10%.

title: Sea Thug

name: Alpha Gobfin Ignis
description: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power  to control fire!

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  attacks targeted enemy with Spirit Fire.  When this Pal uses Spirit Fire,  it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.  While in party,  increases the player's Attack by 10%.

title: Volcano Thug

name: Alpha Lamball
description: A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move,  making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom  of the food chain itself.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Shield
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  equips to the player and becomes a shield.  Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

title: Big Floof

name: Alpha Quivern
description: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.

partnerSkill.name: Sky Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While in party,  increases Attack of Dragon Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)

title: Snow-White Soarer

name: Alpha Quivern Botan
description: When you hug Quivern Botan, if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.

partnerSkill.name: Grass Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.   While mounted,  changes the player’s attack type to Leaf and increases Attack by 5%.

title: Evergreen Flyer

name: Alpha Beegarde
description: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee.  Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive.  It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

partnerSkill.name: Worker Bee
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Elizabee's Attack.  Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch.

title: Captain of the Guard

name: Alpha Suzaku
description: It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought the previous year,  people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Flame
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku)

title: Ruler of the Crimson Dawn

name: Alpha Suzaku Aqua
description: It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. Whenever there was a flood the previous year,  people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Water
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku Aqua)

title: Ruler of the Cobalt Dusk

name: Alpha Woolipop
description: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves  overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Candy Pop
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch.  While at a base,  reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -10%. (Does not stack)

title: Giant Cotton Candy

name: Alpha Woolipop Terra
description: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter.  Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.

partnerSkill.name: Bitter Pop
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Caramel Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch.   While at a base,  reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -15%. (Does not stack)

title: King-Sized Confection

name: Alpha Turtacle
description: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell.  Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath.  Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.

partnerSkill.name: Spikey Carrier
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  reduces Ore weight by 80%. (Does not stack)

title: Mini Fortress

name: Alpha Beakon
description: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk,  but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.

partnerSkill.name: Thunderous
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While mounted,  changes the player's attack type to Electricity and increases Attack by 5%.  This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Electricity Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon)

title: Wings of Thunderbolt

title: Windborne Seedling

name: Alpha Amione
description: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione, companionship is everything.

partnerSkill.name: Magical Twin Powers
partnerSkill.description: While at a base,  increases the Watering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

title: Miraculously Close

name: Alpha Majex
description: It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply  bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.

partnerSkill.name: Phantasmal Arcana
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy creates flames around itself, dealing continuous damage equal to 15% of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)

title: Flickering Shadow

name: Alpha Tropicaw
description: While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers  swaying in the wind and avoid predators,  others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.

partnerSkill.name: Flower Dance
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps by 15%.  (Does not stack)

title: Blooming Crooner

name: Alpha Ophydia
description: Waters where Ophydias dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form.  Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms,  but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.

partnerSkill.name: Glorious Mist
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.   While in party,  the player's attacks inflict Soak 2.  (Does not stack)

title: Pure Bloom Dragon

name: Alpha Shaolong
description: Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion,  the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership.

partnerSkill.name: Azure Sovereign
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.   This Pal's Attack increases by 4% for each other Dragon Pal in your party.

title: Water God

name: Alpha Leafan
description: To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way!  Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way!  The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is!  The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is!

partnerSkill.name: Selfless Discipline
partnerSkill.description: This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by 2% for each other Leaf Pal in your party.

title: Hardcore Heartbreaker

name: Alpha Elgrove
description: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.

partnerSkill.name: Mother Nature's Menace
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  Elgrove changes the player's attack type to Leaf and increases Attack by {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}%.

title: Verdant Minotaur

name: Alpha Elgrove Cryst
description: Its frozen horn stays solid through its life. When water begins to drip from this ice, Elgrove Cryst feels the chill of its own life slipping away.

partnerSkill.name: Father Winter's Threat
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  grants the player the ability to Freeze enemies afflicted with Soak in one strike.

title: Frozen Minotaur

name: Alpha Lapure
description: It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention,  always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean,  kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.

partnerSkill.name: Long-Sleeved Hurray
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals by 10%. (Does not stack)

title: Pristine Fisticuffs

name: Alpha Silvance
description: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Silvance does not know. After all, the World Tree will tell it everything.  The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is.

partnerSkill.name: Spore Stalwart
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Ivy-Covered, the enemy explodes, dealing additional damage equal to 40% of the player's attack damage.
