name: Smokie
description: The black flames are merely warm to the touch,  but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside.  Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

partnerSkill.name: Dig, Smokie! Dig!
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite.   While fighting together,  Chromite acquisition increases by +100%.

name: Smokie Cryst
description: The blue flames are merely cool to the touch,  but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes. Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!

partnerSkill.name: Cryo Instincts
partnerSkill.description: While at a base,  increases the Cooling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

name: Celesdir
description: Ancient texts refer to it as the |Beast of Salvation.|  The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything, literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Purification
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.   This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increases by 2% for each other Normal Pal in your party.   When in party,  recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by 0.15% per second. (Does not stack)

name: Celesdir Noct
description: Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born. It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be. Balance is what the world requires.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Chaos
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.   While in party,  the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for {ReferencePassive1_EffectValue1}% Attack increase. (Does not stack)

name: Panthalus
description: The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart. Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled,  its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.

partnerSkill.name: Resonant Guardian
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.   Only 1 can be summoned to a base.   While at a base,  it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above.

name: Omascul
description: The mask it wears is not its face, they say. It seems in front, but it's not there, no way. From shadows deep, it watches night and day. Glance away, and closer it will stray.

partnerSkill.name: Masquerade Dance
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Party Pals' EXP gained by 40%. (Does not stack)

name: Hoodle
description: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.

partnerSkill.name: Void-Dweller
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat by 50%. (Does not stack)

name: Sekhmet
description: Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility.

partnerSkill.name: Desert Empress
partnerSkill.description: While at base,  boosts Anubis's work speed by 20%.  Increases efficiency by 30% if Sekhmet is also working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)

name: Slowatt
description: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.

partnerSkill.name: Chillswitch
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify, the enemy discharges electricity, dealing damage equal to 40% of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

name: Splatterina
description: It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart. Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment. If caught by Splatterina, pray that your head is taken first.

partnerSkill.name: Blade of Uncontrolled Passion
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases by 100%.  (Does not stack)

name: Tarantriss
description: Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its |personality.|

partnerSkill.name: Tarantriss’ Web
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  Can double jump while mounted.   Additionally, can shoot spider web to grapple and move at high speed.

name: Azurmane
description: Like Univolt, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God.  As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God's true envoy. Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.

partnerSkill.name: Plasma Dash
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  Grants Air Dash, to move at even higher speeds.

name: Pierdon
description: It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.

partnerSkill.name: Power Stone
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Muddy by 50%. (Does not stack)

name: Pierdon Cryst
description: It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape. Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.

partnerSkill.name: Power Crystal
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  player and party Pals take 15% less Dragon damage. (Does not stack)

name: Gloopie
description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some  truly awkward misunderstandings.

partnerSkill.name: Sticky Princess
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  the capture gauge decreases 12% more slowly while the bars are not overlapping during the fishing minigame.  (Does not stack)

name: Gloopie Primo
description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some  truly unnecessary concern.

partnerSkill.name: Cephalo-Princess
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases Defense of Water Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)

name: Whalaska
description: When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it.  Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake,  it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.

partnerSkill.name: Chilled Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party,  fishing minigames start with the capture gauge increased by 5%.  Additionally, while the bars overlap, capture progress increases by 5%.  (Does not stack)

name: Whalaska Ignis
description: Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again,  it turned bright red through sheer will. Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red. So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.

partnerSkill.name: Cozy Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.   While in party,  fishing minigame begins with the capture gauge 7% higher than usual, and capture progress increases by 7% while the bars overlap. (Does not stack)

name: Jelliette
description: A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy. It’s very social, so when plans overlap,  it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date.

partnerSkill.name: Jelliette Drop
partnerSkill.description: While in party,  increases items obtained from fishing by 55%.   While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jelliette's watering speed increases by 50%. (Does not stack)

name: Rampaging Kitsun
description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee  into a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.

partnerSkill.name: Wolf of the Sun
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Ice damage and are immune to Freeze. (Does not stack)

title: Rampaging

name: Rampaging Vanwyrm
description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While in party,  increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 20%. (Does not stack)

title: Rampaging
